video_title: ‘Karl-Anthony Towns is making me proud’ - Perk praises KAT’s maturity in the NBA Finals | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks must maintain intensity and avoid letdowns against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: It can't be, oh, we're going to act like this energy ain't here. Use it. Live in it.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Don't let up. It ain't no effing letups. It can't be, oh, we're going to act like this energy ain't here. Use it. Live in it. This is a moment. I think that people fail to realize sometimes, I get the even-kill situation, but y'all did y'all job. Y'all went and stole two on the road. Now do exactly what y'all supposed to do and come in here and roll.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Usually when they come in here, they play like this is our home crowd. We're going to start from the jump and we're going to play well. I know they feel like Jalen Brunson is going to play well, but in that locker room it has to be, don't ignore it, don't act like it's not happening, live in it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs are struggling to maintain confidence in a hostile environment
quotes.excerpt: I feel like right now in this moment, I'm listening to the Spurs and they're trying to talk themselves up.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I feel like right now in this moment, I'm listening to the Spurs and they're trying to talk themselves up. They're trying to keep their hopes and confidence alive. You're walking into a dangerous atmosphere tonight. Don't give them no confidence.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: If I'm on the opposite side, if I'm Miss Johnson, I'm telling the Spurs, we got to get off to a great start. We want to take the life, the energy and the crowd out of the game.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's leadership and anger are driving the Knicks' success
quotes.excerpt: Brunson is angry and he just needs to stay angry. He's a leader and they'll all follow him.
quotes.quote: I'm not even worried about their mindset because Brunson is angry and he just needs to stay angry. He's a leader and they'll all follow him. He doesn't want to take photos or be in the room with the trophy. He looks pissed off after every game. He's a man on a mission and they will follow him.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks need to finish the series now to avoid a comeback
quotes.excerpt: What does a boxer do? You got a guy on the ropes, you go for the knockout.
quotes.quote: What does a boxer do? You got a guy on the ropes, you go for the knockout. What do they do in soccer when you get up by two? They say kill the game. Kill the series. That's what the Knicks can do tonight.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns shows significant growth and maturity in recent months
quotes.excerpt: I'm watching a whole different level of maturity right now, even in his interviews and in his game.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns is making me proud. Just watching the growth of him, not just this year, but I'm talking about over the last three months. I'm watching a whole different level of maturity right now, even in his interviews and in his game. And he's getting it done all across the board.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns's skill in the pick-and-roll is a major asset
quotes.excerpt: He's running the pick-and-roll. You have a small guy setting the screen on Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: He's running the pick-and-roll. You have a small guy setting the screen on Wembanyama, and this is what you call tomato chest, going through his chest, putting Castle in the basket and flexing. Here's why you can't switch. They put a smaller De'Aaron Fox on Karl-Anthony Towns. He caught the ball in traffic, collapsed four defenders, and one thing he is great at is making the damn pass and making guys around him better.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns's physical defense is key to his impact
quotes.excerpt: Touch him up. I don't care if it's Wembanyama. No, we going to get physical.
quotes.quote: Touch him up. I don't care if it's Wembanyama. No, we going to get physical. I'm going to play without fouling, everything's going to be tough. I'm going to put a body on, get up. Get up. I'm letting you know I'm here.
